2610.08165.title: Which alloy composition,what process parameters? Inferring the recipe from optimized metallic microstructure and texture
2610.08165.paper_summary: The mechanical properties of a metallic alloy are set by its microstructure and texture: the size and shape of its grains and the orientation of their crystals. That structure is in turn set by a recipe, the alloy composition together with the processing parameters. Alloy development runs this chain forwards, tuning the structure until a target property is met. Running it backwards, from an optimized structure to the recipe that would produce it, still relies on expert knowledge. We ask whether this backwards step can be learned. On an in-house dataset of 107 magnesium alloy extrusion conditions across 14 alloys, each with optical micrographs and an X-ray texture measurement, we compare three descriptors of microstructure and texture: conventional grain and texture statistics, a vision embedding from a pretrained image encoder, and a graph neural network on the grain network. Each is paired with prediction heads for two tasks: the alloy composition given the process (Task A), and the process parameters given the composition (Task B). Under 5-fold cross-validation, the conventional descriptors identify the correct alloy for 65% of held-out conditions, against 17% for always guessing the most common alloy, while the learned embeddings stay below 30%. The process parameters are recoverable but noisier: compared with using the composition alone, the microstructure roughly halves the temperature error. Because only a few alloys were cast and only a few press settings were used, both answers are discrete, and heads that pick from these known options, while respecting their order, worked better than heads that predict a free value.
2610.08165.paper_summary_zh: 金屬合金的機械性能由其微觀結構和質地決定：顆粒的大小和形狀以及其晶體的取向。該結構又由配方設定，即合金成分加上加工參數。合金開發向前推進這一鏈條，調整結構直到達到目標性能。反向運行，從優化結構到能產生該結構的配方，仍然依賴於專家的知識。我們詢問這一步驟是否可以學習。在一個內部數據集上，涵蓋14種合金的107種鎂合金擠壓條件，每種合金都有光學顯微圖像和X射線質量測量，我們比較了三種微觀結構和質地的描述符：傳統的顆粒和質地統計、來自預訓練圖像編碼器的視覺嵌入，以及在顆粒網絡上的圖神經網絡。每個描述符都與兩個任務的預測頭配對：給定過程的合金成分（任務A），以及給定成分的過程參數（任務B）。在5折交叉驗證下，傳統描述符識別出65%的保留條件的正確合金，而始終猜測最常見合金的準確率為17%，而學習的嵌入保持在30%以下。過程參數是可恢復的，但噪聲較大：與僅使用成分相比，微觀結構大約減少了一半的溫度誤差。由於只有少數合金被鑄造，且僅使用了少數壓力設置，因此兩個答案都是離散的，從這些已知選項中選擇的預測頭在尊重其順序的情況下表現得比預測自由值的預測頭更好。
